metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the dark rehearsal, the clear note, the short loaf, and the full moon.

yesterday: Heminges counted seven days to Easter Monday. There was no bill on the door. The paste stayed the one paste, and the book stayed one book.
Sam sang the cuckoo clear. Arthur's hooks stayed split. You did not let the hem down.
The loaf is a finger and a half, and a penny. You paid threepence.
The almanac had the full moon. You did not begin a king.
